title: CleanBC Roadmap to 2030
summary: Released 25 October 2021. Sets the provincial sectoral pathways to BC's 2030 target. Still the operative provincial plan as of August 2026.
oc_use: The provincial target OC's own reduction pathway has to sit inside. Sets the sectoral ceilings for buildings, transport and industry that constrain what OC can claim.
source_notes: Released 25 Oct 2021. Still BC's operative 2030 plan, not superseded.

title: CleanBC Roadmap to 2030: Local Government summary
summary: Two-page local-government framing of the Roadmap, including the funding and planning supports available to local bodies.
oc_use: Short enough to attach to a briefing note. Useful for explaining provincial direction to a non-technical audience.
source_notes: A separate general-audience 2-pager exists at cleanbc_roadmap_brochure.pdf; confirm which copy is held.

title: BC Energy Step Code and Zero Carbon Step Code: Best Practices Guide v3.0
summary: Version 3.0, June 2024. SUPERSEDED: the provincial Step Code resources page now links version 3.2. This copy is the archived edition.

source_notes: SUPERSEDED. The Step Code resources page now links v3.2 at .../stepcodes_guidebook_v32.pdf. Record v3.2 as the live citation and v3.0 as the archived copy.

title: 20%-Better Energy Efficiency and Zero Carbon Step Code bulletin
summary: Dated 1 May 2023. Sets out the performance and prescriptive routes to the 20%-better requirement and the Zero Carbon Step Code levels EL-1 through EL-4.
oc_use: The specific compliance levels a new OC building would be designed to. Pairs with the VFA building list for retrofit target setting.
source_notes: Dated 1 May 2023. Covers ZCSC levels EL-1 to EL-4.

title: 2030 Emissions Reduction Plan
summary: Environment and Climate Change Canada, March 2022. Catalogue En4-460/2022E-PDF. The federal sectoral plan underpinning the 2030 commitment.
oc_use: Federal context for the target ladder. Rarely cited directly by an institution, but sets the national trajectory OC's numbers roll up into.
source_notes: Cat. En4-460/2022E-PDF. URL read off catalogue record publications.gc.ca/site/eng/9.909338. Not fetched: publications.gc.ca serves an archived-notice interstitial. PDF replaced 2 Jun 2022 at ECCC request.

title: 2025 Progress Report on the 2030 Emissions Reduction Plan
summary: Catalogue En4-460/1-2025E-PDF, iv plus 243 pages, issued March 2026. Supersedes the 2023 progress report. The most recent federal progress assessment.
oc_use: Shows whether the national trajectory is on track, which is the honest framing for any OC target that references federal ambition.
source_notes: Cat. En4-460/1-2025E-PDF, iv+243 pp. Canada.ca issued 11 Mar 2026. Supersedes the 2023 progress report. Same interstitial prevented fetching.

title: Canada's 2021 Nationally Determined Contribution
summary: Submitted to UNFCCC 12 July 2021. The 40 to 45 percent below 2005 by 2030 commitment. Superseded as Canada's latest NDC by the 2035 submission but still the operative 2030 pledge.
oc_use: The internationally registered 2030 number. Use this rather than a news figure when stating Canada's commitment.
source_notes: Submitted 12 Jul 2021. 40-45% below 2005 by 2030. Superseded as latest NDC by the 2035 submission but remains the operative 2030 commitment. The UNFCCC registry index now surfaces only the 2035 entry, so keep this direct file URL.

title: Canadian Net-Zero Emissions Accountability Act
summary: S.C. 2021 c.22, assented 29 June 2021, consolidation current to 17 June 2026. The source URL always serves the newest consolidation, so this copy will drift from the live statute.
oc_use: The legal architecture behind the 2050 target. Cite the statute rather than a policy document when the plan asserts a legislated obligation.
source_notes: S.C. 2021 c.22, assented 29 Jun 2021, consolidation current to 17 Jun 2026. This URL always serves the newest consolidation, so the held copy will drift. Record the current-to date alongside it.

title: Canada's 2035 Nationally Determined Contribution
summary: Submitted to UNFCCC 11 February 2025. Commits Canada to 45 to 50 percent below 2005 levels by 2035, roughly 381 to 419 Mt CO2e, as a step toward net zero by 2050. Canada's current NDC and a progression from the 40 to 45 percent 2030 target.
oc_use: The newest federal commitment, and the top of the domestic target ladder. Use this rather than the 2030 NDC when the plan's horizon runs past 2030.
source_notes: Core text runs to roughly 30 pages with annexes covering legislative requirements, engagement submissions and provincial input, reaching about 188 pages in total. Corroborated against the UNFCCC NDC registry entry and the ECCC news release of February 2025.

title: Paris Agreement, full text
summary: The standalone Agreement text, Articles 1 to 29, adopted 12 December 2015. Sixteen pages.
oc_use: The top rung of the target ladder. Quote Article 2 rather than paraphrasing 'the Paris target'.
source_notes: 16 printed pages, matches the held copy. A longer 27-page UNFCCC edition exists at resource/english_paris_agreement.pdf; that is not the match.

title: Decision 1/CP.21, Adoption of the Paris Agreement
summary: Document symbol FCCC/CP/2015/10/Add.1. The COP21 decision with the Agreement annexed.
oc_use: The formal citation for how the Agreement was adopted. Needed only where a document has to be cited precisely.
source_notes: Typeset edition, ~60 pp, matches the held copy. The plain ODS version of the same symbol is at unfccc.int/resource/docs/2015/cop21/eng/10a01.pdf (~36 pp) if the shorter typeset is what is held.

title: IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report: Summary for Policymakers

title: Vernon Local Government Climate Action Program survey and attestation
impact_areas: Performance Measurement; Policy / Planning; Carbon Zero
summary: Signed and submitted 31 July 2024, reporting on the 2023 calendar year. The reporting year is not printed on a cover page; it appears in the question wording, which asks about emissions measured 'for the 2023 calendar year'. Vernon's own stated targets in this submission are 50 percent by 2030, 75 percent by 2040 and 100 percent by 2050, all steeper than the provincial 40 / 60 / 80 legislated targets.
oc_use: Shows the provincial survey-and-attestation format local governments file, a useful comparator to OC's own CCAR template. More usefully, it records a neighbouring municipality voluntarily committing beyond the provincial target, which is a relevant reference point when OC sets its own ambition.
source_notes: Confirmed as the July 2024 submission covering calendar 2023, so this is the correct source URL. A separate August 2025 submission covering calendar 2024 exists at vernon.ca/sites/default/files/2025-09/ and is a different document. BC publishes only the aggregate LGCAP summary, not individual municipal submissions.
